feeds.title: The Trading Post at Bear Spring Eco Retreat Blog
feeds.description: Owned and operated by Solita Work passionate about living life as sustainably as possible without sacrificing comfort. That's why they post all the tips and tricks learned over the past decade and showcase projects and issues that they think are relevant and important. Browse their blog and learn more about services, articles, workshops, products, and more.

feeds.title: Reep Green Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Reep Green Solutions is an environmental charity that has been helping people in Waterloo Region live sustainably for 20 years. Our mission is to empower the community with the practical tools, knowledge and capacity for action to make sustainable living the norm.

feeds.title: Sustainability at Brock
feeds.description: Read the sustainability news at Brock University. Climate change, biodiversity loss, pollution, forest degradation. If hearing these terms sparks feelings of fear, dread, anger, and sadness, you are not alone.

feeds.title: A Sustainably Simple Life
feeds.description: A Sustainably Simple Life was created by the two of us, Krista and Alison. While our lives differ with respect to family, housing, and work, both of our core beliefs focus on sustainability, simplicity, and being budget-conscious. Both of us love to share our journeys-the mistakes and the successes-through blogging, so in 2019 we decided to team up and A Sustainably Simple Life was born!

feeds.title: pointA Blog
feeds.description: Get to know about transportation options for businesses that can help with improved sustainability. Affordable programs to help you reach your sustainability goals. Shifting to more sustainable transportation modes reduces the negative impacts of congestion and creates a healthier and happier workforce.

feeds.title: Green Action Centre Blog
feeds.description: Green Action Centre is a non-profit, non-governmental organization, based in Winnipeg and serving Manitoba since 1985. Our primary areas of work are green commuting, waste reduction through composting and recycling, sustainable living and resource conservation.

feeds.title: Sustainability Solutions Group Blog
feeds.description: Sustainability Solutions Group is a team of over 30 members and associates. Our confluence of diverse disciplines, personalities, cultures, and expertise is empowering cities with the very best in climate planning approaches. Our co-operative of experts in energy, policy, and design inspire sustainable buildings, communities, and organizations.

feeds.title: Shoo-Foo
feeds.description: The Shoo-foo lifestyle was born out of a desire to create change. As the founder of Shoo-Foo, my passion for sustainability led me to pursue a degree in Ecology. Being trained as an ecologist, I saw the potential of bamboo to be an eco-friendly option in the textile world and started to make bamboo baths and bed linens.

feeds.title: Carbon49
feeds.description: Carbon49 is a blog on sustainability for Canadian businesses. Founded by sustainability consultant Derek Wong, it aims to share practical information and experiences that Canadian businesses can use in their operations and strategic planning.

feeds.title: Sustainability Leadership
feeds.description: Sustainable Hamilton Burlington (SHB), a non-profit, social enterprise, was originally launched as Sustainable Hamilton in June 2011 by Sandi Stride. We inspire sustainability leadership within the area's businesses and other organizations. By helping organizations to realize the economic benefits of sustainable practices, we harness the influence of this sector to create measurable, community-wide positive change.

feeds.title: University of Waterloo » Sustainability
feeds.description: Waterloo is actively developing a sustainable future. As the University continues to grow, this commitment to sustainability is also reflected in our own operations, including ongoing efforts to minimize waste, reduce emissions, and shrink our environmental footprint.

feeds.title: My Green Closet
feeds.description: Hey, there. I'm Verena Erin. Thanks for dropping by! My Green Closet is a blog and community about slow fashion, sustainability, and living more aligned with your values. Here you'll find guides, resources, tips, and thought-pieces to help you on your personal journey.

feeds.title: Simplify Living Blog
feeds.description: What started as an outlet to share my passion for environmental issues quickly turned into something more. Today, Simplify is a welcoming community for anyone who wants to learn more about easy, effective ways to implement zero-waste solutions into their everyday life. Our mission is to inspire sustainability through zero waste products and a supportive community.

feeds.title: Sustainable Severn Sound Blog
feeds.description: Sustainable Severn Sound Blog shares information on local climate efforts, suggest solutions, and share ideas that will accelerate local action. SSS's main goal is to mitigate climate change by reducing greenhouse gas emissions through the integration of climate supportive policy within municipal planning.

feeds.title: AspenClean » Sustainable Living
feeds.description: Learn natural, eco-friendly tips for keeping your home green and healthy. Includes checklists, how-tos, and more from the experts of AspenClean. Learn recommendations on sustainable living from the sustainable, eco-friendly cleaning experts.

feeds.title: Generate Canada
feeds.description: The Natural Step Canada is a dynamic non-profit organization with over a decade of experience helping organizations and individuals understand and make meaningful progress toward sustainability. Our vision is a sustainable society - one in which individuals, communities, businesses and institutions thrive within nature's limits. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a sustainable society.

feeds.title: A Greener Future Blog
feeds.description: A Greener Future works hand-in-hand with local communities to promote environmental preservation through organized litter cleanups, educational programs, and events. Our expanding family of volunteers are committed to creating a clean, healthy environment that can be sustained for generations.

feeds.title: Random Acts of Green
feeds.description: Random Acts of Green is a social enterprise with a vision to build a glocal (global + local) climate action community where everyone is empowered to take action together and promote environmental sustainability. Our mission is to prove that we can all make changes that add up to make a big collective impact.

feeds.title: GVI Canada Blog
feeds.description: GVI tackles critical local and global issues by operating award-winning education and training programs on sustainable development projects around the world, in partnership with renowned international partners.
